svg.title: Twelve engineering format representations
svg.desc: The cards show BDF, INP, and UNV geometry; VTU, legacy VTK, MSH, and classic Exodus meshes with supported fields; STL triangle facets; SU2 boundary markers; FRD nodal results; and OP2 and PCH displacements requiring separate meshes.
svg.text: Each adapter carries a documented subset of mesh identity, topology, and results.
See the format limits for supported routes and reported losses.
Sets and solver data are omitted
ASCII arrays; metadata can be lost
Physical groups read; sets not written
IDs assigned on read; binary float32
Matching mesh and node IDs required
Schematic only: field availability depends on the source; OP2 and PCH need matching meshes.
